attributed_subsystem: QCA firmware + proprietary airMAX/LTU module + ath10k

executive_summary.litbase_hardware_rom_invariant: CONFIRMED (QCA firmware): All 4 QCA988x target firmwares share identical entrypoint bytes at BEGINADDR = 0x00983c00 (`366100210014a101...`) where `0x00983c03: 21 00 14` (`l32r a2, imm16=0x1400`) loads `seg[0][0]` (`0x00980000`) using the QCA988x Mask ROM `LITBASE = 0x009bb001` (`base = 0x009bb000`).
executive_summary.hook_tables_symmetry_and_openwrt_diff: CONFIRMED (QCA firmware + proprietary airMAX/LTU module): All 3 Ubiquiti firmwares (`ptp_bin`, `ptmp_ap_bin`, `ptmp_sta_bin`) allocate a `10,888`-byte `seg[2]` (`.data`) containing two 32-pointer hook tables at the exact same relative offsets: `Initial Hooks` at `seg[2]+0x2928` (`0x0040f608` PtP, `0x0040fac8` PtMP AP, `0x0040fb78` PtMP STA; `15/32` slots active, `17/32` NULL) and `Full Polling Hooks` at `seg[2]+0x29a8` (`0x0040f688` PtP, `0x0040fb48` PtMP AP, `0x0040fbf8` PtMP STA; `32/32` slots active). In contrast, OpenWrt `QCA988X/hw2.0/firmware-2.bin` (`10.1-ct-8x-__fW-022-ecad3248`) has a `3,044`-byte `seg[2]` (`7,844` bytes smaller) with zero Ubiquiti polling hook tables, saving `62,028` bytes of target SRAM vs `ptmp_ap_bin` (`228,588` B vs `304,572` B uncompressed).
executive_summary.wmi_htt_and_rx_decap_modes: CONFIRMED (QCA firmware + proprietary airMAX/LTU module + ath10k): `umac.ko` `htt_h2t_rx_ring_cfg_msg_ll` (`0x0d5298..0x0d5488`) sends `HTT_H2T_MSG_TYPE_RX_RING_CFG` (`0x0102` at `0x0d5380`) with 10 hardcoded RX descriptor dword/byte offsets (`0x003e002e`, `0x0019000f`, `0x000e0003`, `0x00090006`, `0x00020001`). In `ptmp_ap_bin` and `ptmp_sta_bin` (`is_ubnt_ptp=0`), `scn->host_80211_enable = 1`, so when `polling_enabled=0` (`allow_80211=1`), `ol_rx_deliver` (`0x0cd7c0`) decapsulates 802.11+LLC/SNAP headers into Ethernet on the host. In `ptp_bin` (`is_ubnt_ptp=1`), `__ol_ath_attach` (`0x0bc0f0`) forces `host_80211_enable=0`, so uninstalling `Full Polling Hooks` (`0x0040f688`) leaves neither target nor host decapsulating 802.11 data headers (`FMX-DISC-42`). Meanwhile, OpenWrt `ath10k` (`firmware-2.bin` `10.1-ct` / `firmware-5.bin` `10.2.4`) uses `ATH10K_HW_TXRX_NATIVE_WIFI` (`1`) / `RAW` (`0`) into `mac80211` (`ieee80211_rx_napi`).

rx_decap_modes_matrix.athwlan_AR9888v2_ptp_bin_polling_1: Target Full Polling Hooks (0x0040f688) decapsulate TDMA container -> Ethernet; host ol_rx_deliver (host_80211_enable=0) passes directly to eth_type_trans.
rx_decap_modes_matrix.athwlan_AR9888v2_ptp_bin_polling_0: BROKEN CATCH-22 (FMX-DISC-42): Target uninstalls Full Polling Hooks (0x009af2c4) AND host has host_80211_enable=0 (0x0cd7c0), dropping all 802.11 ARP/IPv4 data.
rx_decap_modes_matrix.athwlan_AR9888v2_ptmp_ap_bin: Target Full Polling Hooks (0x0040fb48) for TDMA CPEs + host_80211_enable=1 (0x0cd7c0) for allow_80211=1 standard WDS STAs.
rx_decap_modes_matrix.athwlan_AR9888v2_ptmp_sta_bin: Target Full Polling Hooks (0x0040fbf8) when polling=1; when polling=0 (Normal AP), host_80211_enable=1 decapsulates 802.11+LLC/SNAP in ol_rx_deliver (0x0cd7cc..0x0cdb4c).
rx_decap_modes_matrix.openwrt_firmware_2_ct_and_firmware_5: Standard HTT T2H Native WiFi / Raw 802.11 delivery into mac80211 (with mac80211_teb_4addr_v3_6.6.110.ko stripping inner 0x6558 ETH_P_TEB and gating BIT(19) on BIT(3) WLAN_STA_AUTHORIZED).
